caption: Scan indexed vault paths and review the rule groups.
eval: await (async () => { for (const [path, body] of [['Vault Path Portability/CON.md', 'Sample Windows reserved name.'], ['Vault Path Portability/What next?.md', 'Sample unsafe punctuation.']]) { if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path)) await app.vault.create(path, body); } for (const leaf of app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown')) leaf.detach(); return 'Sample files created in the dev vault'; })()

caption: The report groups Note.md and note.md as a case-fold collision.
eval: await (async () => { for (const path of ['Vault Path Portability/Note.md', 'Vault Path Portability/note.md']) { if (!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path)) await app.vault.create(path, 'Case collision example.'); } for (const leaf of app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown')) leaf.detach(); await app.plugins.plugins['vault-path-portability'].showReport(); if (!document.querySelector('.vpp-report')?.textContent.includes('Case-fold collisions')) throw new Error('Case collision finding missing'); })()

caption: Copy the complete report as Markdown.
Free-tier review shows the disabled Pro rename action and a manual rename option.
eval: await (async () => { for (const leaf of app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown')) leaf.detach(); await app.plugins.plugins['vault-path-portability'].showReport(); const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('.vpp-path')].find(row => row.querySelector('code')?.textContent === 'Vault Path Portability/CON.md')?.querySelector('button:last-child'); if (!button || button.textContent !== 'Review rename') throw new Error('Rename review action missing'); button.click(); })()
